title: Obsidian Armor and More
description: This mod adds Obsidian Armor and more items made from obsidian
body:
This mod adds obsidians armor, which craft using Better Broken Obsidian. Better Broken obsidian craft using Broken obsidian and one netherite:

![Better Broken Obsidian Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f470832302005a0407b9e86c31105ba12ff37e79.png)

Broken Obsidian is burned obsidian:

![Broken Obsidian Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c33f1afb6309fbdaa020b62247dadbf9db92c0d3.png)

Obsidian is it burns out for a long time.
"KLATKA Z OBSYDIANU" is in Polish "obsidian cage" and craft like this:

!["KLATKA Z OBSYDIANU" Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/618fb54456da75873f9ce18831bbc6f2720e82fd.png)

"KLATKA Z OBSYDIANU" create cage from obsidian with cobweb inside.
Obsidian Armor give you fire aspect.
